newsitem.title: UK: OPEC members say June output down at 24.63 mbpd.
newsitem.headline: OPEC members say June output down at 24.63 mbpd.

text.p: OPEC pumped 24.63 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude in June, down from 25.39 million bpd in May, according to member country submissions, OPEC headquarters said on Friday.
OPEC supply to the market in June was 24.55 million bpd, down from 25.28 million bpd, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said in a monthly report from the group's Vienna secretariat.
By comparison, a Reuters survey, one of four used by OPEC to monitor its members' production trends, put June output at 26.39 million bpd from 26.82 million in May.
At its June ministerial meeting in Vienna, the 11-member group renewed its combined official ceiling of 25.03 million bpd for a further six months and stressed its commitment to quota compliance.
The OPEC secretariat said it had revised up its estimate for 1997 world oil demand by 50,000 bpd to 73.26 million bpd.
